text: Attention neighbors! Our Saturday Repair Café is moving from the library to the Community Hall. This change provides more space for our projects. Volunteers, please arrive at 9:30 AM to set up. Visitors are welcome starting at 10:00 AM. We look forward to seeing you there for a morning of fixing and community connection.
task: Write a notice explaining that a fictional neighborhood repair cafe will move its Saturday session from the library to the community hall. Volunteers should arrive at 9:30 and visitors at 10.
